scope: THE STANDING POSE DERIVATION: the first non-zero pose the class records lawfully admit. The pose target is DERIVED, not chosen: a small constrained optimization over the recorded DOFs (SLSQP, bounds = the recorded ranges, constraints = the two hip seats under the committed 3.0 mm touching-class cut) whose objective is the operational definition of standing — the four distalmost limb-end pads near one plane (population variance along the pads' least principal axis) plus the trunk near level w.r.t. that plane (sin^2 of the trunk-to-plane pitch), commensurated at the rest state. The lawfulness battery (ranges / P6' v2 on the hips through the transition path / tarsal loop closure / 0-DOF immobility / mass invariance / contact-release predictions derived from the DOF paths / determinism / theta=0 identity) owns void; the proven triangle render path (/mesh_bin) shows the operator the before/after. Read-only on the kernel, the engine, the tris bins, the committed definition, and every prior lane's artifacts; the lane's writes are its own directory plus the two byte-identical provenance modules and the walker pin the render path consumes.

rule_0.statement: THE CLASS RECORDS ADMIT A LAWFUL NON-ZERO POSE, AND THE OPERATIONAL DEFINITION OF STANDING (PADS NEAR ONE PLANE, TRUNK NEAR LEVEL W.R.T. THAT PLANE) DERIVES IT AS A SMALL CONSTRAINED SOLVE FROM THE CORPSE AS THE START. Someone can disagree: the objective may not be THE standing (a curled fetus can satisfy pads-coplanar + trunk-level — the design-time readings say the scan is nearly flat-packed: V_rest = 1.94384 mm^2, d_rest = 0.010404), and the solved angles may be so small the pose looks like the corpse. Both disagreements are answered with numbers: the solved coordinates, the achieved objective, and the rendered before/after stills are recorded whichever way they land.
